name: Longer Ray5 10W
tagline: 10W Compact fixed-focus diode: simple desk engraver for small projects
tldr: Longer Ray5 10W is the 10W SKU on the Longer longer ray5 line. Longer's compact Ray5 20W diode engraver: verify you are buying the 20W SKU, not the 5W, 10W, or 40W Ray5 listings. Verify optical power on the listing: do not assume combined-watt marketing.

priceRange.note: Official Longer store, Oct 2026: $240 to $720 depending on bundle

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Finest spot of the Ray5 range: 0.06 × 0.06 mm according to Longer
Basic set at $239.99 on Longer's store (October 2026)
Full 400 × 400 mm area per Longer, with kits that add air assist or rotary
cons: Slow fills of ~5–10 mm/s in our benchmarks: a 10 × 10 cm photo takes ~28–43 min
A 3 mm basswood square takes ~14–24 min to cut
Longer's 8 mm one-pass rating is far above what our cut benchmark suggests
beginnerNotes: This profile is the 10W SKU on Longer Ray5. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks above, then compare other power options via the chips before buying.
proTips: Run material test grids at engraving speeds first. Add air assist for light cuts. If cut jobs exceed ~30% of your week, open the higher-watt profile on this site and compare times.
mainObjective: High-quality hobby and light-business engraving with light, slow cutting

editorialDepth.advantages: Longer Ray5 10W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 5 mm+ cutting in production: see 20W or 40W in the line. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.

faq.question: Why does the 10W have the finest spot of the Ray5 range?
faq.answer: Longer quotes a 0.06 × 0.06 mm spot for the 10W module, against 0.08 × 0.08 mm for the 5W and 0.08 × 0.10 mm for the 20W. That makes it the Ray5 to pick for small text and photo detail, even if its fills are slow: about 5–10 mm/s in our benchmarks.

faq.question: How thick can the Ray5 10W cut?
faq.answer: Longer rates it for 8 mm basswood in one pass. In our benchmarks a 10 × 10 cm square in 3 mm basswood takes about 14–24 min at 2–3 mm/s, so plan around 5 mm as the realistic limit in passes. Air assist (in Longer's cutting kit) helps a lot.

faq.question: Ray5 10W or 20W?
faq.answer: On Longer's store in October 2026 the basic sets were $239.99 (10W) and $399.99 (20W). The 20W is rated for 15 mm basswood in one pass and cuts our 3 mm square in about 9–15 min, but its spot is wider and Longer lists a slightly smaller 400 × 365 mm area. Detail-first engravers keep the 10W; cutters pay the $160.

standoutFeatures.title: 0.06 mm spot
standoutFeatures.body: Longer's finest Ray5 spot, good for small lettering, portraits and detailed line work.

standoutFeatures.title: Cutting kit option
standoutFeatures.body: Longer's $299.99 cutting kit adds air assist and a honeycomb bed, the two upgrades that matter most for cuts.
